usage: Step 1 : Apply adequate amount of bodywash on wet skin. Step 2 : Post bodywash, take some scrub and massage into skin using gentle, circular motions. Step 3 : Post shower, apply the moisturizing lotion all over the body Note: Use bodywash & lotion everyday. Use Scrub 1-2 times a week for best results

list.title: How long must I use this pack to see results?
list.content: You will notice visible reduction in skin texture with 2-3 months of use. With KP or strawberry skin: changes depend on the severity of the condition, it is recommended to get in touch with an expert for your speicific case.

list.title: What are the side effects of this pack?
list.content: There are no side effects. However, we always recommend you to do a patch test before using any skincare product for the first time.

list.title: What else can I use with this pack?
list.content: You can use your regular spot treatments and sprays along with this kit. However - we don't recommend using retinol and vitamin c based based products on your body when using this kit.

list.title: Why should I use this bodywash?
list.content: Enriched with Salicylic Acid - this is a bodywash that does more- it cleanses your pores, prevent acne formation and also helps gently exfoliate skin.

list.title: Will the lotion leave my skin sticky?
list.content: No, this lightweight formula absorbs very quickly into the skin. It won't leave your skin sticky.

sections.text: Take a handful of body scrub and apply it on a wet body. Gently scrub the body in circular motions. Focus on the neck, elbows, knees, underarms & feet. Rinse with warm water and pat dry. Follow up with body wash.

On wet skin, take some body wash in your palms or on a loofah. Massage this salicylic acid body wash into skin using a gentle, circular motion. Once done using this body wash containing salicylic acid, rinse.
